Prisen inkluderer et måltid med mat og drikke på lørdag. Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take away tilbud i nærområdet. Vi følger lokale koronarestriksjoner. Pr dd er det ingen særlige krav eller restriksjoner i Oslo. ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2022! This is the first cube competition in Oslo since 2015! You can register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). items.information: Day 1 (April 1st) will be located in the Senate Chamber of the Ohio Union. The Senate Chamber is on the west side of the second floor next to the Archie M Griffin West Ballroom. If you need help locating the Senate Chamber, there is a help desk on the first floor, as well as multiple maps around the building. Days 2 and 3 (April 2nd and 3rd) will be located in the East Auditorium of the Rhodes Center at the Ohio Expo Center. A map of the expo center will be provided in the **Travel** tab. **Day 1:** 3x3x3 Fewest Moves **Day 2:** 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Square-1, Face-Turning Octahedron, Mirror Blocks **Day 3:** 3x3x3 Cube, 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, Pyraminx, Skewb Due to venue constraints, we will be enforcing a competitor limit of **38** for 3x3x3 Fewest Moves on a first come, first serve basis. Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue: 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Friday, March 18th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. OR 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Monday, March 28th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. **Refund Information: Due to venue financial requirements, no refunds will be issued after March 3rd, 2022 unless there are extreme circumstances. These circumstances include the following: ** * **Competitor contracts COVID-19 within 14 days of the competition and must withdraw** * **Other Injury or Sickness that would prevent the competitor from attending** * **Competition as a whole is cancelled** * **Any specific excuse deemed acceptable by an organizer or delegate** **We understand that some may need to cancel their registration after the refund date due to unforseen events or circumstances; however, due to financial constraints, we will only be refunding competitors if they meet one of the previously mentioned conditions. We thank you for your understanding.**

items.information: **[FR]** **Suite aux annonces par le gouvernement du Québec sur le [Passeport vaccinal](https://www.quebec.ca/sante/problemes-de-sante/a-z/coronavirus-2019/deroulement-vaccination-contre-la-covid-19/passeport-de-vaccination-covid-19/lieux-et-activites-exigeant-passeport-vaccinal-covid-19), tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront présenter leur passeport vaccinal et une pièce d'identité avec photo à l'entrée du site de compétition. L'accès à la compétition sera refusé à tous ceux qui ne peuvent présenter un passeport valide. Un questionnaire d'accueil devra également être rempli au préalable, voir l'[onglet Preuve de vaccination](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) pour plus de détails. Dans l'éventualité où les directives gouvernementales changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.** Également, il est à noter que **les citoyens étrangers qui désirent voyager au Canada doivent être admissibles au statut de [voyageurs entièrement vaccinés](https://voyage.gc.ca/voyage-covid/voyage-restrictions/voyageurs-vaccines-covid-entrent-canada) et suivre les instructions détaillées sur le site du gouvernement canadien.** Veuillez lire **tous les onglets** sur cette page web. C'est très important. En raison de la COVID-19, **il y aura des nouveautés même pour les compétiteurs chevronnés**. Portez une attention particulière à l'[onglet Santé & Sécurité](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) ainsi qu'à notre [Plan d'atténuation des risques](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing) conforme aux directives de la WCA. Note : **un (1) accompagnateur maximum par compétiteur**. Si vous n'êtes pas un compétiteur ou accompagnateur, nous vous demandons de ne pas venir. Note : Dans le cas où la situation en lien avec la pandémie COVID-19 devient drastiquement pire et que les directives changent, il se peut que la WCA annule la compétition. Les mises à jour importantes seront affichées sur ce site et envoyées directement par courriel aux compétiteurs. **[EN]** **As per the Quebec government's recently announced [Proof of Vaccination Requirement](https://www.quebec.ca/en/health/health-issues/a-z/2019-coronavirus/progress-of-the-covid-19-vaccination/covid-19-vaccination-passport/places-and-activities-requiring-covid-19-vaccination-passport), all competitors and their (single) guest must present a valid proof of vaccination and a valid piece of ID with photo in order to enter the venue. Also, a welcome questionnaire will have to be filled, see the [Vaccination proof tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16692-preuve-de-vaccination-vaccination-proof) for more details. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the government updates its regulations.** Moreover, note that **individuals arriving from outside of Canada need to qualify as [fully vaccinated travellers](https://travel.gc.ca/travel-covid/travel-restrictions/covid-vaccinated-travellers-entering-canada) and follow the canadian government policies detailed on the website.** Please **review ALL of the tabs listed on this website**. This is a priority. **Even if you are a seasoned competitor, COVID-19 has created some new conditions** and there are things to be particularly attentive to. Take clear note especially of the [Health and Safety Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TroisRivieres2021#16495-sante-securite-health-safety) and our full WCA-compliant [Risk Mitigation Plan](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1J-chgIfmLQXCUG1fXK5kZr0Bovynngmy/view?usp=sharing). Note: **Only one (1) spectator per competitor** can attend. **If you're not a competitor or the single guest of a competitor, then we ask you NOT to come.** Note: **In the unlikely event that the COVID-19 situation concerningly worsens**, the WCA may step in and cancel the competition. Significant updates such as these will be posted here on the website and emailed to registered competitors.

items.information: This is the fourth Copper Country Cubing competition, and we're looking forward to welcoming you to the Michigan Upper Peninsula! It's been a long time since anyone has been able to compete, so this event features two long events on Saturday evening and the more common NxN events on Sunday. We plan to host another competition this Fall with more of the non-NxN puzzles, so look out for it! As this competition takes place on the Michigan Technology University campus, it is subject to Michigan state laws, University campus policies, and WCA policies. We will monitor all of these sources for any changes to safety protocols and requirements. Please note that if community or regional health problems surface again or severely worsen, the competition may be forced to cancel. There is a 40 person Competitor Limit for this competition. Please sign up early to ensure a spot, and please read the "Waiting List" tab for additional information on registration for the competition. If the competition is running ahead of schedule and has enough competitors we would love to add an additional round to 3BLD, 3OH, and/or 6x6. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador (conforme previsto no Regulamento da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Competidores baianos terão preferência para receber prêmios nos eventos. Caso não tenham três competidores baianos com resultados válidos em um evento, outros competidores poderão receber prêmios, respeitada a preferência dos competidores da Bahia. --------------------------------------------------------------- Registration is open to all, of all nationalities. Aiming at the smooth running of the competition, when registering, you also make yourself available to help as a judge or scrambler (as stated in the WCA Regulations). This is a way for the competition to become sustainable, and the tasks are shared between all competitors, not becoming a heavy load just for a few. Competitors from Bahia will have a preference for receiving prizes in the events. items.information: 2019 ist das Jahr in dem Speedcubing Competitions den Westen Österreichs erreichen. Nach Vorarlberg gibt es nun auch eine in Tirol! Das Organisationsteam organisiert auch Räume in einer Jugendherberge im Nachbargebäude. Bei Interesse, wirf bitte eine Blick in den Travel/Accomodation Tab! ______ 2019 is the year that Competitions start spreading to the west of Austria. After Vorarlberg, we are happy to announce the first ever Competition in Tirol! Tirol is entirely mountainous with one big valley (the Inn Valley) stretching its entire length. This valley is big for tyrolean standards but for first-time visitors it might just seem tight as well. The organisation team is also organising Rooms in a youth hostel next door. If you are interested in this, take a look at the Travel/Accomodation tab!

items.information: Vous n'êtes pas obligé d'arriver au moment de l'enregistrement, nous vous accepterons sans aucun problème si vous arrivez dans la journée. Essayez simplement d'être là au moins 30 minutes avant votre première épreuve. Une pièce d'identité vous sera demandée si c'est votre première compétition. **Merci de nous prévenir par e-mail si finalement vous ne pouvez pas participer à la compétition.** **REPAS** : Les samedi soir et dimanche soir, nous vous proposons un repas collectif et des jeux, sur le lieu de la compétition. Samedi soir, pour 10€ : * Des diots (saucisse de porc Savoyarde) et des crozets (une alternative végétarienne/végétalienne devrait être disponible, merci de nous le préciser) * Un dessert, incluant des gourdes de compote de pomme ou des fruits, un yaourt et peut-être un gateau Dimanche soir pour 15€ : * Une grande pizza (au choix, commande le jour J) * Un dessert, comme le samedi **LASER GAME** : Le samedi soir, nous allons au Laser Game ensemble, nous arrangerons les voitures avec les personnes présentes. Nous avons la grande salle, de 21h50 à minuit pour 2 parties de 45 minutes. Vous pouvez participer aux deux pour 28€ (à régler au Laser Game) ou une pour 15€. Merci de préciser dans la section "Commentaire" de votre inscription si vous comptez venir, et si vous êtes accompagnés, car il y a un nombre limité de places ! --- You are not obliged to be here at registration time, we will accept you if you come during the day. Try to be here at least 30 minutes before your first event. We'll ask for an ID if it's your first competition. **Please send us an email if you cannot participate after all.** **DINNERS**: On Saturday and Sunday evening, we propose a dinner all together, and games, at the competition venue. Saturday evening for 10€: * "Diots" (Savoyarde pork saussage) et "crozets" (a bit like pasta) (a vegetarian/vegan alternative should be availble, please ask us) * A dessert, including an apple jam or fruits, a yogurt and maybe a cake Sunday evening for 15€: * A big pizza (to be chosen on the day) * A dessert, like on Saturday **LASER GAME**: On saturday night we will go to play Laser Game together, we'll arrange shuttles with the cars available. We will have the main room from 21h50 to midnight for two 45 minute games. You can play in both for 28€ (to pay at the Laser Game) or one for 15€. Please mention in the "Comment" section of your registration to the competition if you're coming and if you are alone or with guests. There are limited spots!

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

This way, competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in the other you'll help as staff.

items.information: (HR) Croatian Nationals 2019 je trinaesto natjecanje po redu koje se održava u Hrvatskoj od 2011. godine. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom. Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Članovi Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska ostvaruju 25% popusta na kotizaciju. Također, natjecanje je priznato kao Nacionalno Prvenstvo te će se dijeliti nagrade za najbolja 3 Hrvata u svim disciplinama. -------------- (EN) Croatian Nationals 2019 is the 13th speedcubing competition being held in Croatia since 2011. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. Members of Speedcubing Association Croatia have 25% discount on the registration fee. This competition is also recognized as Croatian National Championship and top 3 Croatians in all events will be additionally awarded, alongside regular podiums.
